state:
Goal `core-validate-and-1-more`: `Core\Validate::isAscii` is finished. It has its about page, three examples, a bench, an attack and a Rust `covers:` test, and its card is plain.
`Core\Validate` has its class card now, so the help proof for the other five `Core\Validate` members owes only a plain member card each.
The member cards for `isEmail`, `isDomain`, `isIp`, `isMac` and `isPrintable` are still in the dense "Answers whether …" voice. Rewrite each one in the slice for that member.
Nothing is blocked.

items.text: **`Core\Validate::isDomain`** — owes about, examples, hostile, perf, tests (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). The Rust test already exists at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/validate.rs:770` and needs only a `// covers: Core\Validate::isDomain` line above its `#[test]`. Rewrite the card at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/validate.rs:264` in the plain voice. `docs/examples/core/Validate/isAscii/` is the model for the other files. The bench declares `allocations 0` and `calls 0`, indexes with `(($total + $i) % 3) as int` and adds a multiple of 3 on every path, so that every input is visited.

**`Core\Validate::isEmail`** — the same list. Its Rust test is `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/validate.rs:706`, which needs a `covers:` line, and its card is `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/validate.rs:248`. The attack should include the 254-byte and 64-byte bounds, and a subject of many megabytes.

backlog: `isIp`, `isMac` and `isPrintable` are not on this goal's item list, but their cards share the dense voice. When they are listed, they reuse the same file set. The owner is `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/validate.rs`.
Goal item 3 of 3, the `Core\Xml` member, follows the `Core\Validate` pair. The owner is `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/xml.rs`.
